propositions: Read CLI surfaces (show, list, search, ready) that route through ensure_fresh can return empty stdout with exit 0 under writer-storm contention, violating output integrity.

The reconverge lock timeout (_RECONVERGE_LOCK_TIMEOUT=2s) prevents indefinite stalls but the ed2b regression test covers only show; list/search/ready/next-batch lack per-surface coverage and regress silently.
Every read surface must emit parseable JSON for its documented shape (dict/list) or exit nonzero; valid-empty ([] or {}) must be distinguishable from truncated-empty stdout when exit 0.

Throttle marker /tmp/.ticket-sync-<md5(tracker)> permits only 1 reconverge per minute, so read tests must clear _clear_sync_throttle before each invocation to actually exercise the contention path rather than short-circuiting.
Parameterized property test reuses the ed2b harness (repo_with_origin_tickets + _rebar_cli + background REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=always bursts) across all read surfaces under concurrent write load.
